# 三列：表名 / key / 新文本；两列则默认 Dialogue 表
# ── 程大爷 → 程大娘（名字 + 所有提到她的台词，含第三人称「他」→「她」）──

column3: 程大娘
column4: Granny Cheng

column3: 我是程大娘，也在这区里经营着一家小店。
column4: I'm Granny Cheng. I run a little shop in this district too.

column3: 你好，是程大娘让我来这里的。
column4: Hi, Granny Cheng sent me here.

column3: 程大娘那里常备着一些过了期但还能凑合用的药。
column4: Granny Cheng always keeps some expired-but-still-usable medicine on hand.

column3: 而且她卖得一向公道。
column4: And she has always charged a fair price.

column3: 有时碰上付不起钱的人，她甚至还肯赊账。
column4: Sometimes she even lets people buy on credit when they can't pay.

column3: 可她现在没货了。
column4: But she's out of stock right now.

column3: 所以她让我来找你。
column4: So she sent me to you.

column3: 你认识程大娘，对吧？
column4: You know Granny Cheng, right?

column3: 我小时候流落街头，是她给了我饭吃。
column4: When I was a kid living on the street, she was the one who fed me.

column3: 要不是她，我早就饿死了。
column4: If not for her, I'd have starved long ago.

column3: 我听说她最近总是很晚才开店，
column4: I heard she's been opening up really late lately,

column3: 说实话，我很担心她。
column4: Honestly, I'm worried about her.

column3: 帮我多留意一下她，好吗？
column4: Keep an eye on her for me, will you?

column3: 你应该认识程大娘吧？
column4: You know Granny Cheng, I take it?

column3: 她昨晚在睡梦中去世了。
column4: She passed away in her sleep last night.

column3: 她是个好人，也是下层区社区真正的顶梁柱。
column4: She was a good woman, and a real pillar of the lower level community.

column3: 有件东西，留给你纪念她。
column4: There's something she left for you, to remember her by.

column1: # ── 屠夫（wanted2，本 mod 里是女版）：被捕时治安部那句 ──

column3: 靠！她力气也太大了！快多叫点人来！
column4: Damn! She's way stronger than she looks! Get more people over here!

column3: 今天，乔治奥给你带来了一项她亲自完成的发明……
column4: Today Georgio brings you an invention she finished herself...

column3: 她有私吞吗？没有！她给你带回来了。
column4: Did she pocket any of it? No! She brought it all back to you.

column3: 好了，乔治奥要回到她的飞船上去了……
column4: All right, Georgio has to get back to her ship now...

column3: [请她帮个忙（下层区声望{0}+）]
column4: [Ask her for a favor (Lower Level reputation {0}+)]

column3: 直到她被捕了！
column4: Until she was arrested!

column3: 杰克逊博士也告诉我，你同样没有去拜访过她。
column4: Dr. Jackson told me too - you haven't gone to visit her either.

column3: *她从夹克口袋里掏出几张便签，放在了柜台上。*
column4: *She pulls a few sticky notes from her jacket pocket and sets them on the counter.*

column3: 她要掏枪！她要掏枪！
column4: She's going for her gun! She's going for her gun!

column3: 把她铐起来。
column4: Cuff her.

column3: 你也知道，她这人不太愿意开口。
column4: You know how she is - not exactly the talkative type.

column3: 没关系，朋友。乔治奥相信你会亲自喂饱她。
column4: That's all right, friend. Georgio trusts you'll feed her yourself.

column1: # ── 改造体鉴别指南：第三条视觉特征（芯片 → 附耳触手）──
# ── 埃莉诺的叔叔 → 姑姑（贴图是女脸）──

column3: 埃莉诺的姑姑
column4: Eleanor's Aunt

column1: # ── 埃莉诺的叔叔 → 姑姑（台词部分补全）──

column3: 你好啊。你认识埃莉诺，对吧？我是她的……姑姑。
column4: Hello there. You know Eleanor, don't you? I'm her... aunt.

column3: 我姑姑？我根本没有姑姑。
column4: My aunt? I don't have an aunt.

column3: 她给我留了个箱子？还是被报了失窃的？
column4: She left a crate for me? The one reported stolen?

column3: *告诉她那个自称是她姑姑的女人的事*
column4: *Tell her about the woman claiming to be her aunt*

column3: 那个箱子不是我的，我也根本没有姑姑。
column4: That crate isn't mine, and I don't have an aunt.

column1: # ── 全女性化补完（保守版：只改称呼与单个「他」，「他们」保持原样；可逐条删）──

column3: 受伤的女人
column4: Wounded Woman

column3: 她还说，以后不该再由我来维护它了。
column4: She also said I shouldn't be the one maintaining it anymore.

column3: 我看，她是在劝我退休。
column4: I think she's telling me to retire.

column3: 她正在建造一艘宇宙飞船！好去整个星系拾荒……
column4: She's building a starship! To go scavenging across the whole system...

column3: 她看到你昨晚把东西落在垃圾场了……
column4: She saw you leave something behind at the dumping ground last night...

column3: 她托乔治奥把这封信交给你。乔治奥没偷看。嗯，没怎么看。
column4: She asked Georgio to bring you this letter. Georgio didn't peek. Well - not much.

column3: [请她一周后再来]
column4: [Ask her to come back in a week]

column3: 还记得我那位“客人”吗？她总算肯开口了。
column4: Remember that "client" of mine? She finally decided to talk.

column3: 她告诉了我一个人的下落，我跟那人有笔账要算。
column4: She told me where to find someone. I have a debt to settle with them.

column3: 抓住她！
column4: Grab her!

column3: 有个人做得太过火了，我们得给她点颜色看看。
column4: Someone has gone too far. We ought to teach her a lesson.

column3: 别人爱怎么骂怎么骂，但她接掌指挥权后，生活质量已经在慢慢改善了。
column4: Let them say what they like - since she took command, living conditions have been slowly improving.

column3: 认为她只为上层区服务。
column4: They think she only serves the upper levels.

column3: 但她真的是在竭尽全力维持这个空间站的运转。
column4: But she really is doing everything she can to keep this station running.

column3: 她涉嫌腐败，我们已经签发了逮捕令。
column4: She is suspected of corruption. We have already issued an arrest warrant.

column3: 此外，她还被发现在执勤期间饮酒。
column4: She was also found drinking while on duty.

column3: 如果见到她，务必立即举报。
column4: If you see her, report it immediately.

column3: 不要试图与她交谈。
column4: Do not attempt to talk to her.

column3: 她可能携带武器，非常危险。
column4: She may be armed and is extremely dangerous.

column3: 把她装袋带走。
column4: Bag her and take her away.

column4: Her bounty has been raised to {0} credits.
